feature: Merge overlapping IB activity CSVs into a trade ledger + latest snapshot
summary: IbStatement stays one CSV report. load() returns IbBook (latest snapshot + account ledger). ingest_statement inserts new fills, skips overlap, never deletes trades. Snapshot from newest period_to. --rebuild replays archived U*.csv. Live v1 sqlite migrated in place (130 trades kept).
verify: test_ib_statement 20 passed; analysis_web tests 251 passed; eng_verify PASS 859; live book 130 trades / 21 positions after v2 migrate; overlap temp db 130 skipped + 1 inserted = 131; Playwright 8772 /portfolio trade_count 130, 21 names, union disclaimer
notes: Interfaces: parse_activity_csv → IbStatement; ingest_statement → IngestResult; load → IbBook; build_portfolio_view(ib_book=).
Trade identity is fingerprint (account, category, currency, symbol, traded_at, qty, price, discriminator). First-write-wins. MTM not in the key.
snapshot.trades is empty on load so period dates cannot silently filter the ledger.
Import still copies CSV/PDF into .local/ib/statements/ and does not write portfolio.json.
Existing :8765 will not pick this up until restart (uncommitted files).
follow_ups: Daily NAV curve from stored trades + Yahoo + FX
risks: Do not commit live statement CSV/PDF or portfolio.sqlite (PII, gitignored).
Fingerprint without Trade ID can collide on two true fills with the same symbol/time/qty/price.
A 3-month file with a later period_to will drive TWR/NAV while trades stay all-time — the page disclaimer states that.
proposed_commit: Merge overlapping IB statements into a trade ledger plus latest snapshot
